name: Abaddon
description:
Abaddon is an alternative Discord client written in C++ and GTK 3 designed for high performance and low memory consumption. It provides a native, responsive chat experience without the heavy resource footprint associated with Electron-based applications.

Features:
- Integrated voice chat support including listening and speaking
- Native GTK 3 interface with customizable themes and fonts
- Support for direct messages, group chats, servers, and channels
- Rich message rendering including Markdown, embeds, custom emojis, and reactions
- Minimal CPU and RAM usage compared to the official desktop client
